items.title: AyanDict 3.0.0 Released
items.blurb: AyanDict - simple yet advanced multi-lingual cross-platform offline dictionary for desktop, using Qt and Go - Release v3.0.0 · ilius/ayandict

items.title: OpenClaw 2.0 Releases with Simplified Setup and Collaborative Agents
items.blurb: OpenClaw has released OpenClaw 2.0, a major update to the open-source personal AI agent that changes its installation process, browser interface, memory, skills, automations, plugins, security, and collaboration features.

items.title: Cats-Actors 2.2.0 is released
items.blurb: Cats-Actors is a Cats Effect native actor library: typed messages, functional state, supervision, and the familiar ! operator, all in F[_]. What is new in this release: - ControlledTestKit, a new trait in the cats-actors-testkit module.

items.title: Amazon Quick now lets you build custom apps with natural language -
items.blurb: Now generally available, Amazon Quick lets you build custom applications by simply describing them in natural language. Create project trackers, customer dashboards, and training portals in minutes instead of months.

items.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports sharing job bundles
items.blurb: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports sharing job bundles, giving teams a simple way to distribute and reuse render job templates without manual file distribution.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights now supports self-managed PostgreSQL
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces support for self-managed PostgreSQL databases in Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights.

items.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports a dry run feature to validate API requests
items.blurb: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports a dry run feature to check whether an API request would succeed without executing the operation.

items.title: AWS Backup now supports protecting more than 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets per account
items.blurb: AWS Backup now supports backup and restore of more than 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets per account, matching the Amazon S3 bucket quota configured for your account. Previously, AWS Backup for Amazon S3 supported up to 1,000 buckets per account.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support compact mode
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now offers compact mode on the analytics dashboards, increasing data density so supervisors can see more of their operational data without scrolling.
